name: btn-hover-left-flip
title: Left Slide Flip Button
blurb: Text slides to the left as coloured background slides in from the right.
description: A button with two overlaid text layers: a light one that slides left out of view on hover, and a dark one that slides in from the right to replace it.
use_when: A CTA that should feel smooth and interactive.
avoid_when: When text must remain stable or visible.
a11y: Native button element. Duplicate text may confuse screen readers.
